src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/172c83340c3ccd9712ad68a5eea73b38150fa151.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h2][b][i]UPDATE[/i][/b] Game Mode[/h2][p]Players can no longer perform any actions while in the pregame dugout phase.[/p][p]The following changes around the game mode are to balance some inconsistencies we have been seeing with the flow of the game.[/p][p]We want to discourage players from diving at the goalie, so we are making an update to the goalie's targeting, movement, and damage.[/p][p]We want to encourage playing summons more strategically around the Goalie to get maximum damage.[/p][p]The goalie not clearing summons on KO really helps the push stay active and incentivizes the defenders to actually defend instead of just letting the goalie go down to clear the src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/a2ca02155e21f5f7e7a15ca362f89f0ee91dff42.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Tab Screen Update[/b][/p][list][*][p]Full Decks are now displayed[/p][/*][*][p]The screen is now a toggle[/p][/*][*][p]Hover cards for details[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/94bbab01e582b31f88049f2f46d2e18415f0798f.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Victory Screen 50% damage.[/p][list][*][p]Summons With the Keyword[/p][list][*][p]Infernus[/p][/*][*][p]Janz[/p][/*][*][p]Floraphant[/p][/*][*][p]Gorrit[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Summons[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an better.[/p][list][*][p]With this, we removed the horizontal slowdown from jump spamming[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Scrap and talent pick-ups have been tweaked to be Werebear[/p][/*][/list][h3]Neva[/h3][p]We didn’t like how Neva could abuse the use of going in and out of her Ultimate, so we are changing when the Ultimate can be used.[/p][p]We saw that the hack was not lasting long enough to be impactful, and at times would not reach where you thought it would.[/p][list][*][p]Ultimate can no longer activate at 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Early Access talent changed from activating from 25% → 50%[/p][/*][*][p]Special ability mechanical hack duration changed from 4s → 6s[/p][/*][*][p]Special ability silence duration changed from 1.5s → 3s[/p][/*][*][p]Special ability where you can move while transforming into the ultimate[/p][/*][/list][h3]Locke[/h3][p]Volt was being used a lot more than intended, with the amount of damage it was dealing. We want to slow the use of Volt but also change the base damage to do less per target. Whereas the talent to Crit will bring that damage up.[/p][list][*][p]Volt damage from 50 → 25[/p][/*][*][p]Jump velocity changed from 1900 → 1800[/p][/*][*][p]Gravity changed from 4 → 5[/p][/*][*][p]Special ability cooldown from 25s → 20s[/p][/*][*][p]Movement ability cooldown from 8s → 10s[/p][/*][*][p]Sidekick ability cooldown from 15s → 22s[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Locke’s melee would hit twice[/p][/*][*][p]Can now always jump, and you have to hold to hover[/p][list][*][p]To stop hovering, you have to wait for the time to run out or use another ability[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where his ultimate would not charge[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the ultimate would get canceled while activating[/p][/*][/list][h3]Ragna[/h3][p]We saw that Ragna was not keeping up with other champions as well as we wanted, so we are tuning the fire damage up on her across the board.[/p][list][*][p]Dash ignite stacks changed from 9 → 15[/p][/*][*][p]Special ability ignite stacks changed from 25 → 45[/p][/*][*][p]Ultimate ignite stacks changed from 160 → 90 per hit[/p][list][*][p]Now has 2 hits[/p][/*][*][p]First at 1.12s[/p][/*][*][p]Second at 2.3s[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Jump velocity changed from 2800 → 2000[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where singe would stay around after a KO[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The Road to DreamHack
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503134/947daeefd205e841d89136665f65825cf9d70ea2.png"][/img][/p][p]With the launch of our first-ever Organized Play event, we’re calling on players everywhere to step into the arena and claim their place on [b]The Road to DreamHack[/b], a thrilling, multi-phase series that bridges the final moments of Alpha with the dawn of Early Access.[/p][p]This isn’t just a competition…it’s your chance to be part of something bigger. It’s a milestone moment and a celebration of the community that’s brought us this far. Whether you're in it for glory or a good time, this is your invitation to show up, stand out, and win big. Compete for a seat at DreamHack Atlanta and unlock an [b]exclusive in-game skin[/b] at Early Access launch, just by participating.[/p][h2][b]
The Timeline:[/b][/h2][h3][b]Practice Ladders (Aug 9 - 23)[/b][/h3][p]Kick things off with casual, open ladders each week on [url="https://playwildcard.gg/competition/2294/info/details"]RallyCry[/url]. Top teams win smaller prizes like gift cards, but the real reward is testing strategies and warming up for the qualifiers.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Qualifier Ladder (Sept 6 - 28)[/b][/h3][p]Ranked ladders run every weekend in September. Each team’s performance across four weeks contributes to their position on the leaderboard. The top 2 teams at the end of the Qualifier Ladder automatically earn their invite to DreamHack.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Last Chance Qualifier (Oct 4)
[/b]The next best 16 teams get one final shot in a knockout bracket. The winner secures the last official invite to DreamHack.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Placement Stage (Oct, Date TBD)
[/b]The top 3 qualified teams compete in a series of Matches. Each win earns points. The results determine seeding for the finals.[/p][p][/p][p][b]DreamHack Atlanta (Oct 31–Nov 2)
[/b]Wildcard’s top 12 teams face off live. Two days of Open Brackets lead into the Sunday Champion Bracket at DreamHack Atlanta. [b]$5,000 is on the line.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Qualification & Participation:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The Road to Dreamhack is open to players age 18+[/p][/*][*][p]Qualified teams are eligible for up to $1,500 in travel support per team, for flight, hotel, and/or meal costs. Wildcard will coordinate logistics.[/p][/*][*][p]Players must provide valid ID and passport/visa documentation (non US) upon qualification.[/p][/*][*][p]Teams that fail to provide valid documentation or are unable to travel will be replaced with the next highest qualifying team.[/p][/*][*][p]Must be available to be on-site in Atlanta from Oct 30th to Nov 2nd.[/p][/*][/list][p]‍[/p][p]Think you have what it takes?[/p][p][b]REGISTER NOW at [url="http://playwildcard.gg/"]playwildcard.gg[/url][/b][/p][p]This isn't just a tournament. It's a rallying cry. Compete, qualify, and take your shot at glory from DreamHack Atlanta.[/p][p]‍[/p][p][b]Questions?[/b][/p][p]Hop in the [url="https://discord.com/invite/QZRgv9M2UZ"]Discord[/url] and open a ticket! [/p][p]‍[/p][p]See you in the Arena…[/p]

notes.title: ALPHA 5 IS HERE
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/88ced992e280dae7868d3698c349a7a51f72fc65.png"][/img][/p][h1]🔥CHECK OUT THE CHANGES🔥[/h1][p][/p][h2]Greetings, Champions![/h2][p]Welcome to our latest Wildcard patch! This update brings major improvements, bug fixes, and new gameplay features designed to smooth out match flow, enhance combat clarity, and empower your strategic play. We've addressed core movement issues, revamped match startup logic, fine-tuned champions, and introduced new tools like the KO Recap and Lobby system. There’s also a brand-new Chronos Arena to explore, alongside meaningful updates to summons, mechanics, and UI elements. Dive into all the changes below![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/cc5562f0c3cda22def564b741368dd645d8cdf16.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Jumps now have decreased horizontal movement if you spam them[/p][/*][*][p]Champions' movement speed is decreased when close to the Core by 30%[/p][/*][*][p]Turned motion blur off by default[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where champions could start to capture the Wild Card or Core while dashing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could dash into a vent and stay in it[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where controller sensitivity was not working[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Wild Card would not spawn[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where fire and knockback are not counted from the source, so neither the champion nor the summon will get credit for the KOs and damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed summons attacks to check for line of sight, being alive, and in range before connecting the attack. This helps to address summons doing damage on KO and through the floors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where throwing a card would cause the champions to get stuck inside a summon[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where champions could be picked at the same time[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where champions could be the same if no champion was picked[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New[/h3][list][*][p][b]Can now hold to attack[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added in UI element around reticle so you know when a hold ability can be released[/b][/p][list][*][p]Lockes hover[/p][/*][*][p]Bolgars Sprint[/p][/*][*][p]Werebears Leap[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Lobby Feature[/b][/p][list][*][p]To support the efforts of our organized play, we wanted players to be able to create a lobby game.[/p][/*][*][p]These lobbies have 4 players and will create a game with those 4 players.[/p][/*][*][p]You can only invite someone to a lobby if they are your friend[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Match Flow[/b][/p][list][*][p]We were seeing issues where players would load into the game at different times and gain an advantage by attacking before the other team loaded in.[/p][/*][*][p]The new match flow helps to address that issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Match Steps[/p][list][*][p]Hit Play[/p][/*][*][p]Enter champion select[/p][/*][*][p]Choose your champion and deck[/p][list][*][p]If all players choose what they want to play, the timer will skip to 5 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Players load into the map in a pre-game phase.[/p][list][*][p]Players can now ready up to start the match OR wait until the timer expires.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Players will then see the VS screen.[/p][/*][*][p]After the VS screen, the match will start, and players will spawn in the dugout.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]KO Recap Feature[/b][/p][list][*][p]A lot of times in Wildcard, it may be hard to tell what KO’d you or did damage to you. Now, after each time you are KO’d, you will be presented with where the damage came from.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Arenas and Layouts[/b][/p][list][*][p]Chronos Arena[/p][/*][*][p]Mainline Layout[/p][list][*][p]Vents no longer send cards or champions as far[/p][list][*][p][i]We were seeing gameplay be about venting over to the other side too much just to try and end the game or do damage. notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503134/3617ec443c2c9de1c136c7e561959c0effb06333.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]🔥 WHAT'S NEW IN THIS UPDATE 🔥[/b][/h2][p][/p][p][b]Greetings, Champions![/b][/p][p]We're excited to bring you our biggest update yet! This massive overhaul completely reimagines how champions play, introduces exciting new features, and delivers the combat experience you've been asking for. Jump in the playtests this weekend to try it out![/p][p][/p][h3][b]⚡ MAJOR HIGHLIGHTS:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b][i]Complete Champion Overhaul[/i][/b][i] - All 4 champions rebuilt from the ground up with unique playstyles[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Champion & Summon Skins System[/b] - Customize your look with multiple override options [/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Combat Revolution [/i][/b][i]- Melee cleave attacks, damage windows, and visual damage numbers[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Custom Keybinds[/i] [/b]- Finally! Set up your controls exactly how you want them[/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Enhanced UI[/i][/b] - New summon details panel with comprehensive information[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]🎮 GAMEPLAY PHILOSOPHY[/b]: This update focuses on making each champion feel unique and powerful in their own way. Whether you're a tank player who loves getting in the thick of things, or a controller who prefers tactical gameplay, every champion now has a distinct identity that shines through their abilities.[/p][p][/p][p]⚠️ [b]IMPORTANT NOTES:[/b] [/p][list][*][p][i]Due to the extensive champion changes, we recommend experimenting with different talent builds[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i] [/i]Combat feels significantly different - take time to adjust to the new cleave mechanics [/p][list][*][p]Some of your favorite strategies may need tweaking, but new powerful combinations await![/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Ready to dive in? Let's break down everything that's changed![/b][/p][p][/p][h1]General Updates[/h1][p][/p][h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p]Added custom key binds - Accessible in the options menu[/p][/*][*][p]Champion Skins system with multiple override options [/p][/*][*][p]Summon Details Panel with right-click functionality[/p][/*][*][p]Damage numbers now visible in combat[/p][/*][/list][h2]Champion Skins[/h2][list][*][p][b]Setting a Default Skin:[/b] In the DECK menu, right click on a champion card to see all abilities and set the default skin.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overriding a Skin for a deck:[/b] Within each deck on the champion tab, select what skin you want that deck to use.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overriding a Skin for a match: [/b]When loading into a match, select a skin for the champion that will be applied for that match only.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Summon Details Panel[/h2][list][*][p][i]RIGHT CLICK a summon card in the deck builder to bring up the details page[/i][/p][/*][*][p]View skins, ability info and keyword descriptions[/p][/*][*][p][i]Set default summon skins by RIGHT CLICKING while its in your full card collection[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Once a summon is added to your deck,  you can RIGHT CLICK and override the skin for that deck only[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]Champion Select Changes[/h1][p][b]No duplicate champions allowed on the same team[/b][/p][p][i]With the game being 2v2 we wanted to promote how champions play together not how you can make an OP comp by taking 2 of something.[/i][/p][p][/p][h1]Combat Changes[/h1][h2]Major Combat Updates[/h2][list][*][p][b]Melee attacks changed from single target to cleave-[/b] Hit what you want to hit and prevents hiding behind summons [/p][/*][*][p][b]Damage windows added for attacks[/b] - No more single timestamp damage, now there's a window for better hit detection [/p][/*][*][p][b]Damage numbers turned on[/b] - Better visual feedback for damage dealt[/p][/*][*][p][b]RANGED summons now prioritize FLYING champions and summons[/b]- More counterplay to hovering[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lowered champion movement speed[/b]- Combat relies more on using summons correctly[/p][/*][/list][h1]Keywords[/h1][p][i]These can be found and accessed on the details page of each summon.[/i][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth="135,"][tr][th colwidth="135"][p]Keyword[/p][/th][th][p]Description[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Slow[/p][/td][td][p]Slows enemies movement speed[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Time Dilation[/p][/td][td][p]1 second stun[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Leftover[/p][/td][td][p]Spawns summons on KO[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Blitz[/p][/td][td][p]Targets the objective. Takes time to build up to maximum damage.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Hunter[/p][/td][td][p]Targets the enemy champion[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Overshield[/p][/td][td][p]Gains a shield that absorbs initial damage.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Enrage[/p][/td][td][p]Increases damage done[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]On Summon[/p][/td][td][p]Has an on summon ability[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]On KO[/p][/td][td][p]Has an on death ability[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Link[/p][/td][td][p]Connect to a teammate applying an effect to them[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Ignite[/p][/td][td][p]Does fire damage[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Overclocked[/p][/td][td][p]Increased movement and attack speed[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Thorns[/p][/td][td][p]Does reflective damage when hit[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Knockback[/p][/td][td][p]Knocks an enemy off their feet when hit[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Trample[/p][/td][td][p]Pushes enemies out of the way as they move[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Silenced[/p][/td][td][p]Abilities can not be used while under this effect[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Hacked[/p][/td][td][p]Mechanical summons change to your team[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Duplicate[/p][/td][td][p]Creates more of itself[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Spawner[/p][/td][td][p]Creates other summons[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Critical Hit[/p][/td][td][p]Deals double damage[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Skillshot[/p][/td][td][p]A summon that can be aimed[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Healing[/p][/td][td][p]Heals allies[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Lifelink[/p][/td][td][p]Heals in an aoe for the amount of damage delt[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Regeneration[/p][/td][td][p]Regenerates hp overtime[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Overheal[/p][/td][td][p]Heals more than the base hp[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Taunt[/p][/td][td][p]Draws aggression from enemies[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Ranged[/p][/td][td][p]Deals damage at a distance and prioritizes flying summons and champions[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Horde[/p][/td][td][p]More than one of a summon[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Mechanical[/p][/td][td][p]Made of metal or mechanics[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Flying[/p][/td][td][p]Flies and ignores ground effects[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Melee[/p][/td][td][p]Close combat fighting[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Stationary[/p][/td][td][p]A summon that does not move[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Wear and tear[/p][/td][td][p]Maximum health deteriorates overtime[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Rampage[/p][/td][td][p]Each successful hit increases the damage of the next attack[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Accelerates[/p][/td][td][p]Damage is increased overtime the longer the same target is being attacked[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="135"][p]Amplify[/p][/td][td][p]Gains movement speed overtime[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][h1]Wild Cards[/h1][p][i]FIXED a bug where Wild Cards were not all working.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Cooldown Reduction[/b][i] - Decrease Champion Cooldowns by 50% [/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Temporal Extension[/b] - TIME DILATION duration is doubled [/p][/*][*][p][b]Sharpshooter's Precision[/b][i] - Double the attack range of RANGED summons [/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Heroic Fortitude[/b] - No longer heals you on application[/p][/*][*][p][b]Titan's Strength[/b] - LARGE summons gain 25% increased damage \[/list][/p][/*][/list][h1]Champions[/h1][p][i]We have done close to a full overhaul on our champions. This ranges from movement speed to abilities in their kit. The goal of this is to really allow the player fantasy and playstyle of each champion to shine through.[/i][/p][h2]Bolgar[/h2][p][i]Bolgar is built to fully embody the Tank role, bringing the fantasy of merging with his companion Burr to become the unstoppable Werebear. While the transformation is powerful, it's important that Werebear remains a beatable threat. This update puts greater focus on syncing with Burr, allowing players to tap into the full potential of their bond and become a true frontline menace in the arena.[/i][/p][list][*][p][i]Health: 400 → 300[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Movement speed: 1000 → 925 [/p][/*][/list][h3]BASIC ATTACK[/h3][list][*][p]DPS: 29[/p][/*][*][p]Combo hit 1: 17 damage[/p][/*][*][p]Combo hit 2: 17 damage[/p][/*][*][p]Combo hit 3: 21 damage[/p][/*][/list][h3]Movement Ability[/h3][p]Sprint forward knocking everything out of the way for a duration [/p][list][*][p][i]HOLD to stay sprinting, release to stop [/i][/p][/*][*][p]Duration: 5 Seconds[/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown: 20 Seconds \[/list][/p][/*][/list][h3]Special Ability[/h3][p]Bolgar pulls log off his back and fires the Logzooka, applying KNOCKBACK to everything in range [/p][list][*][p]Cooldown: 25 Seconds[/p][/*][/list][h3]Sidekick Ability - Werebear[/h3][p]Fuses with Burr to become the Werebear [/p][list][*][p][i]Increased Health: 300 → 400[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Basic Attack: 35 Damage per hit[/p][/*][*][p]Movement Ability Werebear: [/p][list][*][p]Leap upwards with knockback on landing [/p][/*][*][p][i](HOLD to leap further)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown: 6 seconds[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Duration: 20 Seconds [/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown: 60 Seconds[/p][/*][/list][h3]Ultimate - Super Werebear[/h3][p][i]Bolgar turns into a Super Werebear[/i][/p][list][*][p][i]On activation: 100 damage and KNOCKBACK[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Health: 300 → 500[/p][/*][/list][p]Super Werebear Basic Attack[/p][list][*][p][i]35 Damage per hit + KNOCKBACK[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Movement: Single use dash with KNOCKBACK[/p][/*][/list][p]Bolgar's Ultimate charges from doing damage to opponents[/p][p][/p][h2]Locke[/h2][p][i]Locke is designed to fully embrace the Controller role and the fantasy of effortless aerial movement. By leaning deeper into his hovering mechanics, Locke introduces the first ranged attack for a champion in the game — seamlessly switching between melee and ranged combat depending on whether he's airborne or grounded.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Movement speed changed from 1200 [i]→ 1050[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3]BASIC ATTACK[/h3][list][*][p]DPS: 56[/p][/*][*][p]Combo hit 1: 25 damage[/p][/*][*][p]Combo hit 2: 25 damage[/p][/*][*][p]Combo hit 3: 25 damage[/p][/*][*][p]Can only be used while NOT in hover mode[/p][/*][/list][h3]Ranged Basic Attack[/h3][list][*][p][i]Single ranged shot: 17 damage[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i] [/i]Can only be used while in Hover mode[/p][/*][/list][h3]Jump Ability - Hover[/h3][list][*][p][i]Press jump to engage/disengage Hover mode[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Hold jump to launch higher [/p][/*][*][p]D[i]uration: 20 Seconds[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown: 30 Seconds[/p][/*][/list][h3]Movement Ability[/h3][list][*][p][i]Long range dash[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown: 5 Seconds[/p][/*][/list][h3]Special Ability[/h3][list][*][p]Creates an area of effect[/p][/*][*][p]TIME DILATION opponents for 1 second[/p][/*][*][p]OVERCLOCK teammates for 5 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown: 35 Seconds[/p][/*][/list][h3]Sidekick Ability- Volt[/h3][list][*][p][i]Attacks nearest opponent with chain damage[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown: 15 Seconds[/p][/*][/list][h3]Ultimate - Full Send [/h3][list][*][p]U[i]nleashes 4 Summons to aid him in fight: Janz, Wotchy, Shooticrue, R-Mor[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Locke's ultimate charges over time[/p][/*][/list][h2]Ragna [/h2][p][i]Ragna is built to embody the Duelist role and the raw fantasy of wielding uncontrollable fire. While her base damage starts lower, her true strength ignites when she chains abilities and fuels her flames — turning up the heat for devastating results. With singe effects and fire-based summons amplifying her power, Ragna thrives when the battlefield is burning.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Movement speed: 1050 → 950[/p][/*][*][p]DPS: 36[/p][/*][/list][h3]Melee Basic Attack[/h3][list][*][p][i]Combo hit 1: 20 damage[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Combo hit 2: 20 damage [/p][/*][*][p]Combo hit 3: 25 damage[/p][/*][/list][h3]Jump Ability[/h3][list][*][p]Press the jump button to jump in the air.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Movement Ability[/h3][list][*][p]Short range dash[/p][/*][*][p]IGNITES any opponents hit by the dash[/p][list][*][p]9 FIRE Damage[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Charges: 3[/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown: 8 seconds[/p][/*][/list][h3]Special Ability[/h3][list][*][p][i]Ragna will dive kick towards ground at the area you are aiming at[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Can only be activated while in the air[/p][/*][*][p]Opponents in the area will be IGNITED[/p][list][*][p]25 FIRE Damage[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Cooldown: 10 Seconds[/p][/*][/list][h3]Sidekick Ability- Singe[/h3][list][*][p]Ragna and FIRE summons deal double fire damage when they IGNITE opponents[/p][/*][*][p]Gains IGNITE on all basic attacks[/p][list][*][p]10 FIRE Damage[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Duration: 10 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]Cooldown: 20 Seconds[/p][/*][/list][h3]Ultimate[/h3][list][*][p][i]Changed from 3 waves to 1 wave of fire[/i][/p][/*][*][p]IGNITES opponents in an AOE:[/p][list][*][p]160 FIRE Damage [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ragna's ultimate charges from doing fire damage to opponents[/p][/*][/list][h2]Neva[/h2][p][i]Neva's core identity revolves around XO — her versatile mech suit — which allows players to dynamically shift between combat states. Whether you prefer the agile Solo Suit, the powerful Mechanized mode, or deploying specialized bots like the CLOB-R_v2 or LAZ-R_v2, Neva adapts to your playstyle. [h2][i]4.25 Update[/i][/h2]  

[h2]GENERAL[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]Can now see champion abilities in the TAB/Select screen in-game  
[*]All dashes are immune to slows while dashing  
[i]Players were experiencing getting double slowed, so using a dash to cleanse a slow was not working as intended.[/i]  
[*]All Ultimates are immune to slows while activating  
[i]Since ultimates are no longer immune to damage, if a player is slowed while using an ultimate, it’s too hard of a counter to shut it down and KO the player.[/i]  
[*]Now immune when walking out of the dugout for 2 seconds  
[*]Can cast and use abilities once having left the dugout  
[/list]

[*]When a Wildcard is captured, a [b]90-second timer[/b] will start  
[*]If the timer runs out, the Wildcards are removed from the players  
[*]If a player is KO’d, the Wildcards are removed from them  
[*]If a player gets a KO, the timer is increased by [b]10 seconds[/b]  
[*]If a player picks up a new Wildcard, the timer resets to [b]90 seconds[/b]  
[/list]
